shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; cat src/main.tsx; printf '\\n--- styles ---\\n'; rg --files -g '*.css' -g '*.scss'"

/bin/bash -lc "U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; sed -n '1,160p' "'$U/README.md; printf '"'\\n--- component files ---\\n'; find "'$U/dist -type f '"\\( -name 'TextInput.d.ts' -o -name 'Select.d.ts' -o -name 'Toggle.d.ts' -o -name 'Checkbox.d.ts' -o -name 'Button.d.ts' -o -name 'Avatar.d.ts' -o -name 'FileInput.d.ts' -o -name 'Card.d.ts' -o -name 'Text.d.ts' -o -name 'Flex.d.ts' -o -name 'Box.d.ts' \\) -print | sort; printf '\\n--- types ---\\n'; for f in TextInput Select Toggle Checkbox Button Avatar FileInput Card Text Flex Box; do p="'$(find $U/dist -type f -name "$f.d.ts" | head -1); if [ -n "$p" ]; then echo "### $p"; cat "$p"; fi; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; ls $U; for f in TextInput Select Toggle Checkbox Button Avatar FileInput Card Text Flex Box; do p=$(find $U -type f -name "$f.d.ts" | head -1); if [ -n "$p" ]; then echo "### $p"; cat "$p"; fi; done'

/bin/bash -lc "U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; echo '### Select types'; cat "'$U/build/cjs/components/Select/types.d.ts; echo '"'### Toggle'; cat "'$U/build/cjs/components/Toggle/Toggle.d.ts; echo '"'### Avatar'; cat "'$U/build/cjs/components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts; echo '"'### FileInput'; cat "'$U/build/cjs/components/FileInput/FileInput.d.ts; echo '"'### Card'; cat "'$U/build/cjs/components/Card/Card.d.ts; echo '"'### Text'; cat "'$U/build/cjs/components/Text/Text.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; echo '### Toggle'; cat "'$U/build/cjs/components/controls/Toggle/Toggle.d.ts; echo '"'### Avatar types'; cat "'$U/build/cjs/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts; echo '"'### ControlProps'; cat "'$U/build/cjs/components/types.d.ts | sed -n '"'1,120p'; echo '### exports'; rg -n \"(FileInput|FormRow|Toggle|Avatar|Card)\" "'$U/build/cjs/index.d.ts $U/package.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; find $U/build/cjs -type d | rg '"'Toggle|FileInput|Avatar|Select|Card"'$'"' | head -30; rg -n \"Toggle|FileInput|Avatar|Card\" "'$U/build/cjs/index.d.ts | head -30; sed -n '"'1,120p' "'$U/build/cjs/index.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc 'U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; find $U/build/cjs/components -maxdepth 3 -type f -iname '"'*oggle*.d.ts' -o -iname '*fileinput*.d.ts'; cat "'$U/build/cjs/components/index.d.ts; cat $U/build/cjs/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/index.d.ts $U/build/cjs/components/Avatar/AvatarText/index.d.ts $U/build/cjs/components/Avatar/AvatarIcon/index.d.ts; cat $U/build/cjs/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts | head -40'

/bin/bash -lc 'U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; find $U/build/cjs/components -maxdepth 4 -type f -name '"'*.d.ts' | rg '(Toggle|FileInput|Switch|avatar)' | head -60; find "'$U/build/cjs/components -maxdepth 2 -type d | rg '"'controls|Toggle|Switch|FileInput'"

/bin/bash -lc 'U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; cat $U/build/cjs/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts; cat $U/build/cjs/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarImage.d.ts; rg -n "useFileInput" $U/build/cjs/hooks/index.d.ts; cat $U/build/cjs/hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find $U/build/cjs/hooks/useFileInput -type f -name '"'*.d.ts' -exec cat {} \\;"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null || true; cat vite.config.* 2>/dev/null || true; cat index.html 2>/dev/null || true'
